metadata.title: Puri Street Food Tour I Odisha Food Walks I Indian Street Food
metadata.description:
Puri  is a city in the state of Odisha in eastern India. It is situated on the Bay of Bengal, 60 kilometres south of the state capital of Bhubaneswar. It is also known as Sri Jagannatha Dhama after the 12th-century Jagannatha Temple located in the city. It is one of the original Char Dham pilgrimage sites for Hindus. 

DFW went on a street food tour exploring the local delicacies mentioned below-


Hotel Padmalaya, Chandanpur
Hotel Battamangla
Shankar Sweets, West Gate, Puri Temple
Nrusingha Sweets, Khajapati
Puri Beach
Bula Sweets
Matar ka Paani 
Malai Poori
Chungwah Restaurant 
Matar ka Paani
Patitapaban Sweets, Nimapada

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
